title: Comfort Club Member Install Credit Amount on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Amount of the member install credit

## Clause

The member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract is the tier's install credit, rounded to the cent half up. The tier's install credit is the member credit on a replacement installation contract set by the Comfort Club tier of the homeowner's agreement in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements terms.

## Order of the computation

1. Flat amounts that join the credit are added to the tier's install credit.
2. That sum is multiplied by each multiplier of the credit in turn, the result of one multiplication being the base of the next.
3. An amount the credit adds after multiplication is added last.
4. Only the final amount is rounded to the cent half up.

A multiplier of 1 leaves the amount unchanged, and an amount of 0.00 adds nothing.

## Worked example (hypothetical agreement)

A hypothetical member on a Comfort Club tier whose install credit is $250.00 signs a replacement contract while the agreement is active. The member install credit is $250.00, rounded to the cent: $250.00.

## Worked order (hypothetical stage values)

| Stage | Computation | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | $250.00 plus flat amounts of $30.00 and $20.00 | $300.00 |
| 2 | $300.00 multiplied by 0.9, then by 0.8 | $216.00 |
| 3 | $216.00 plus $120.40 added after multiplication | $336.40 |
| 4 | Rounded to the cent half up | $336.40 |
